symptom: `alter entity Shop.Order add attribute IsPaid: Boolean default false;` then a datagrid `database from Shop.Order where [IsPaid = true]` in the same script — check: "the constraint on Shop.Order names \"IsPaid\", which is neither an attribute nor an association of it — mxbuild reports this as CE1613"; exec refused. Same for an attribute added by restating the entity (`create or modify`) and an association the script creates. The microflow retrieve form was already fixed (v0.27.0). mendixlabs/mxcli#1271 (comment of 2026-10-16).
cause: validateXPathMembers (widget data source) resolved members with execXPathModel + resolveMemberOnEntity — project only. The retrieve check had been moved to scriptXPathResolver (alteredEntities → unknown, entityDecls → declared attributes, sc.associationEnds for hops); the page walk kept the original resolver.
fix: validateXPathMembers builds the whole-program scriptContext and passes scriptXPathResolver's model and bare-member lookup to unresolvableXPathStepsWith; the project-only wrapper unresolvableXPathSteps had no callers left and was removed. Tests: TestValidateXPathMembers_SeesMembersTheScriptAdds and the typo control TestValidateXPathMembers_ScriptMembersDoNotHideATypo; bug test 1271-page-xpath-member-added-by-script.mdl.
insight: duplicate-resolver-drift: the #1271 fix for retrieves even named the risk ('probably shared with the page XPath walk … not tested') and fixed one copy. When a resolver gains script awareness, grep for every caller of the walk it feeds (unresolvableXPathSteps*) — after this fix the project-only wrapper had zero callers, which is the signal that no copy is left behind. The defect needs the entity to be STORED: a script creating the entity too was silent before and after (unknown entity → memberUnknown), so a self-contained bug test cannot reproduce it — exec a setup section first.
